sources.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
sources.snippet: Abstract 3D simulated environments play a critical role in Embodied AI, but their creation requires expertise and extensive manual effort, restricting their diversity and scope. To mitigate this limitation, we present Holodeck, a system that generates 3D environments to match a user-supplied prompt fully automatedly.
